sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS We will receive proceeds from the purchase of our common stock under the Plan only to the extent that those purchases are of newly issued shares of our common stock made directly from us and not from open market purchases. Any proceeds that we receive from purchases of newly issued shares will be used to repay debt or for working capital and general corporate purposes, including the repurchase of shares of our common stock, and to fund all or a portion of the costs of any purchases of assets related to the management of investment funds that we may determine to pursue in the future. Working capital and general corporate purposes may include expanding our business development activities and distribution channels. We cannot estimate the amount of any such proceeds at this time.
